text:
A steel magnet is placed inside a coil of wire. There is a large alternating current in the coil. The
magnet is slowly moved out of the coil to position P.
coil of wire
steel magnet moved
out of coil
P
12Va.c.
How has the steel changed, if at all, when it reaches position P?
A
It has become a stronger magnet.
B
It has become demagnetised.
C
The poles have changed ends.
D
There has been no change.

options.label: A
options.text: It has become a stronger magnet.
